paragraphs.en: iPhone Duo is available in two refined colors — star white and night sky — and crafted from grade 5 titanium that’s been polished to a mirror finish. iPhone Duo is available in two refined colors: star white and night sky. Pre-orders begin Friday, October 16, with availability beginning Friday, October 23. “iPhone Duo is the most transformational change to iPhone since the original. With an entirely new design and intuitive experiences, it shows what’s possible when hardware and software are engineered together and redefines what it means to use a foldable phone,” said John Ternus, Apple’s CEO. “With the largest display ever on iPhone that still fits easily in your pocket, combined with the power of A20 Pro, iPhone Duo helps you stay more immersed and productive wherever you go, whether you’re enjoying content, multitasking across apps, or gaming.” iPhone Duo features a 7.6-inch inner display that provides a large canvas for viewing content, gaming, and multitasking. Closed, it’s similar in size to a passport with a beautiful 5.4-inch outer display. Two Displays, One Breakthrough Design iPhone Duo delivers Apple’s largest iPhone display in an entirely new design. Closed, iPhone Duo is comfortable to use one-handed and fits easily in a pocket, with a 5.4-inch outer Super Retina XDR display that provides 90 percent of the screen area of iPhone 18 Pro. Opened, the 7.6-inch inner Super Retina XDR display is 50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max, offering an immersive canvas for everything users do. A premium nano-texture finish reduces glare and reflections, creating a matte surface that minimizes crease visibility and feels great to touch. Beneath the inner display, a new FaceTime camera stays hidden when not in use to keep the screen uninterrupted. Both displays share the same aspect ratio, designed for how people use their iPhone, so the experience feels continuous whether iPhone Duo is open or closed. The displays also feature ProMotion, Always On, and 3000 nits of peak outdoor brightness. Later this year, iPhone Duo will support Apple Pencil with USB-C, allowing users to take notes, sketch, or mark up documents on either display. Touch ID is integrated into the side button for easy, secure, and consistent authentication whether iPhone Duo is open or closed, and users can unlock iPhone Duo using their Apple Watch.

paragraphs.en: The design also features Camera Control to quickly launch the camera, including the brand-new Siri Camera mode, which lets Siri see what the user sees to answer questions and take action. The precision hinge on iPhone Duo is designed to feel effortlessly smooth — it supports the center of the display to hold it flat when opened, and together with an integrated magnet array, delivers a satisfying and secure closure. Designed for Durability iPhone Duo is built to last and feels exceptionally solid with every use. It’s crafted from grade 5 titanium for incredible strength, with an enclosure that has an elegant mirror-polished finish and a 3D-printed hinge cover with a contrasting micro-blasted finish. Ceramic Shield protects the back of iPhone Duo, and Ceramic Shield 2 on the front has 3x better scratch resistance than the previous generation. iPhone Duo is also splash-, water-, and dust-resistant with an IP68 rating. 4 The hinge is engineered from more than 100 components to precisely control opening and closing and support the center of the display, delivering a smooth, satisfying feel. Internally, support ribs reinforce the structure for added stiffness, while antenna splits with ceramic fiber inserts enhance the frame’s rigidity. Ceramic Shield protects the back of iPhone Duo, and Ceramic Shield 2 on the outer display reduces glare and provides 3x better scratch resistance than the previous generation. The inner display is designed to withstand the wear of everyday use. A scratch-resistant coating and a nano-textured cover layer — made from a custom polymer with up to 40 percent higher stiffness than other materials used in the industry — protect the surface. High-strength glass sits above and below the folding display panel, with custom adhesives that allow the layers to glide past one another like the pages of a book, relieving bend stress, and a titanium plate at the bottom further enhances durability. An Advanced Camera System with New Experiences iPhone Duo delivers an advanced camera system that brings all-new experiences made possible by its breakthrough design. With the new 48MP Fusion Main camera, users can shoot sharp photos at up to 48MP resolution with zero shutter lag, capture in the 24MP default for incredible image quality at a file size perfect for sharing, and get closer to the subject with an integrated optical-quality 2x Telephoto.

paragraphs.en: Set iPhone Duo down and it enters StandBy on either the outer or inner display — even when it’s not charging — turning the device into a photo frame, hub for widgets, clock, and more. New Calendar and Weather faces join existing Clock and Modular faces, while the Photos face is updated to display Shared Albums. Every face now offers deeper customization, with new colors, fonts, and complications to choose from. The Next Generation of Apple Intelligence and an All‑New Siri iPhone Duo gives users access to Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that is rolling out in beta with iOS 27. Powered by Apple Intelligence, Siri is profoundly more personal, capable, and conversational, and becomes even more useful on the large inner display. Powerful AI capabilities paired with personal context make iPhone Duo an intelligent personal hub with privacy and security at its core. Siri AI can draw on personal context understanding to help users find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; use onscreen awareness to take action related to the content on a user’s screen; and answer questions about virtually any topic. Users can write with Siri by simply describing what they need. The all-new Siri app also makes it easy to revisit past conversations or kick off new ones, with conversational history synced privately across products with iCloud. Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. Users can improve the composition of a photo after it’s been taken with Spatial Reframing, Extend, and upgraded Clean Up. Image Playground also now offers photorealistic imagery, and with upcoming support for the SynthID standard, users can identify images generated or edited with AI. 6 In Safari, Notify Me helps users monitor web pages for changes, like product restocks or price drops, to stay on top of updates. To protect users’ privacy, Apple Intelligence uses on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy and security of iPhone into the cloud. A new chip package inspired by M-series Apple silicon connects A20 Pro directly to a custom vapor chamber, dissipating heat and powering multitasking, gaming, and complex AI workloads. A new display engine drives the inner and outer displays simultaneously and enables a fluid experience as users transition between them. The 6-core CPU is up to 20 percent faster than A19 Pro, delivering the fastest CPU in a smartphone; the 7-core GPU is up to 40 percent faster and more power efficient; and the new Dual 16-core Neural Engine offers 2x the compute power to run on-device AI models. With a new chip package, A20 Pro on iPhone Duo can reach peak performance for on-device AI immediately, and the vapor chamber sustains it for high-frame-rate gaming and multitasking on the large display. Impressive All-Day Battery Life iPhone Duo is designed with one high-energy battery on each side to maximize capacity while efficiently using internal space. A combination of Apple silicon and energy rebalancing algorithms allows the batteries to operate seamlessly as one, so users get up to 31 hours of video playback when using the inner display, up to 44 hours of video playback when using the outer display, and up to 24 hours of usage per charge when both displays are used equally.

sents.en: A new display engine drives the inner and outer displays simultaneously and enables a fluid experience as users transition between them.
sents.zh: 新的显示引擎可同时驱动内屏和外屏，使用户在两者之间切换时获得流畅的体验。

sents.en: The 6-core CPU is up to 20 percent faster than A19 Pro, delivering the fastest CPU in a smartphone; the 7-core GPU is up to 40 percent faster and more power efficient; and the new Dual 16-core Neural Engine offers 2x the compute power to run on-device AI models.
sents.zh: 6 核 CPU 的速度比 A19 Pro 快高达 20%，是智能手机中最快的 CPU；7 核 GPU 的速度快 40% 且能效更高；全新的双 16 核神经网络引擎则提供两倍的计算能力，可运行设备端 AI 模型。

sents.en: A20 Pro also delivers 50 percent more unified memory bandwidth and is built on the latest 2-nanometer process technology.
sents.zh: A20 Pro 还提供 50% 更高的统一内存带宽，并基于最新的 2 纳米制程技术打造。

sents.en: With a new chip package, A20 Pro on iPhone Duo can reach peak performance for on-device AI immediately, and the vapor chamber sustains it for high-frame-rate gaming and multitasking on the large display.
sents.zh: 借助新的芯片封装设计，iPhone Duo 上的 A20 Pro 可立即达到设备端 AI 的峰值性能，而蒸汽腔则能维持这一性能，支持高帧率游戏和在大屏幕上执行多任务处理。

sents.en: Impressive All-Day Battery Life iPhone Duo is designed with one high-energy battery on each side to maximize capacity while efficiently using internal space.
sents.zh: 令人印象深刻的全天续航：iPhone Duo 每侧均配备一块高能量密度电池，在最大化容量的同时高效利用内部空间。

sents.en: A combination of Apple silicon and energy rebalancing algorithms allows the batteries to operate seamlessly as one, so users get up to 31 hours of video playback when using the inner display, up to 44 hours of video playback when using the outer display, and up to 24 hours of usage per charge when both displays are used equally.
sents.zh: Apple 芯片与能量再平衡算法的结合，使两块电池能够无缝协同工作，因此用户在使用内屏时可获得长达 31 小时的视频播放时间，使用外屏时可达 44 小时，而当两块屏幕均等使用时，单次充电可持续使用长达 24 小时。

paragraphs.en: iPhone Duo features a breakthrough foldable design that’s beautiful, versatile, and durable, opening up possibilities that feel entirely new yet remarkably familiar
paragraphs.zh: iPhone Duo 采用突破性的折叠设计，兼具美观、多功能与耐用性，开启了全新而又不乏熟悉感的可能性。

paragraphs.en: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced iPhone Duo , the first foldable iPhone. Opened, it is the thinnest iPhone ever, with a 7.6-inch inner display that provides a large canvas for viewing content, gaming, and multitasking, and a special nano-texture finish that minimizes glare for an unparalleled viewing experience. Closed, the 5.4-inch outer display delivers 90 percent of the screen area of iPhone 18 Pro in a compact, pocketable design. 1 Both displays share the same aspect ratio, so content scales proportionally, ensuring visual continuity. iPhone Duo is built to last with an innovative hardware design and a precision hinge that offers a smooth, satisfying feel with every use. Powered by the new A20 Pro, iPhone Duo features an advanced thermal management system with a custom-designed vapor chamber and a dual-battery architecture, delivering pro performance and impressive all-day battery life. The advanced camera system takes stunning photos and videos, with the folding design unlocking fun new ways to use the camera that aren’t possible on any other iPhone. iOS 27 is reimagined, remaining familiar and intuitive while adapting to the versatile ways users can interact with iPhone Duo. And with Apple Intelligence 2 and Siri AI , 3 iPhone Duo brings powerful AI capabilities together with a user’s personal context.

paragraphs.en: iPhone Duo delivers Apple’s largest iPhone display in an entirely new design. Closed, iPhone Duo is comfortable to use one-handed and fits easily in a pocket, with a 5.4-inch outer Super Retina XDR display that provides 90 percent of the screen area of iPhone 18 Pro. Opened, the 7.6-inch inner Super Retina XDR display is 50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max, offering an immersive canvas for everything users do. A premium nano-texture finish reduces glare and reflections, creating a matte surface that minimizes crease visibility and feels great to touch. Beneath the inner display, a new FaceTime camera stays hidden when not in use to keep the screen uninterrupted. Both displays share the same aspect ratio, designed for how people use their iPhone, so the experience feels continuous whether iPhone Duo is open or closed. The displays also feature ProMotion, Always On, and 3000 nits of peak outdoor brightness. Later this year, iPhone Duo will support Apple Pencil with USB-C, allowing users to take notes, sketch, or mark up documents on either display.

paragraphs.en: iPhone Duo is built to last and feels exceptionally solid with every use. It’s crafted from grade 5 titanium for incredible strength, with an enclosure that has an elegant mirror-polished finish and a 3D-printed hinge cover with a contrasting micro-blasted finish. Ceramic Shield protects the back of iPhone Duo, and Ceramic Shield 2 on the front has 3x better scratch resistance than the previous generation. iPhone Duo is also splash-, water-, and dust-resistant with an IP68 rating. 4 The hinge is engineered from more than 100 components to precisely control opening and closing and support the center of the display, delivering a smooth, satisfying feel. Internally, support ribs reinforce the structure for added stiffness, while antenna splits with ceramic fiber inserts enhance the frame’s rigidity.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone Duo 经久耐用，每次使用都带来格外坚固的质感。 它采用 5 级钛金属打造，强度惊人；外壳拥有优雅的镜面抛光饰面，3D 打印的铰链盖则采用对比鲜明的微喷砂饰面。 Ceramic Shield 保护着 iPhone Duo 的后盖，而前端的 Ceramic Shield 2 抗刮擦能力是上一代的 3 倍。iPhone Duo 还具备防泼溅、防水和防尘功能，并达到 IP68 等级。4 其铰链由超过 100 个组件精密设计而成，可精准控制开合动作并支撑屏幕中心，带来流畅而令人愉悦的使用体验。 内部支撑肋条增强了结构刚性，而带有陶瓷纤维插片的天线分体设计则进一步提升了框架的坚固性。

paragraphs.en: An Advanced Camera System with New Experiences
paragraphs.zh: 全新体验的先进摄像头系统

paragraphs.en: iPhone Duo delivers an advanced camera system that brings all-new experiences made possible by its breakthrough design. With the new 48MP Fusion Main camera, users can shoot sharp photos at up to 48MP resolution with zero shutter lag, capture in the 24MP default for incredible image quality at a file size perfect for sharing, and get closer to the subject with an integrated optical-quality 2x Telephoto. The 48MP Fusion Main camera also benefits from a new computational image pipeline for sharp details, and excels in low light thanks to a large sensor, fast aperture, and sensor-shift optical image stabilization.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone Duo 搭载了先进的摄像头系统，凭借其突破性设计带来了全新的体验。 借助全新的 4800 万像素融合主摄像头，用户可以在最高 4800 万像素的分辨率下拍摄清晰的照片且完全无快门延迟；默认以 2400 万像素进行拍摄，可在确保惊人图像质量的同时保持适合分享的文件大小；此外，集成式光学级 2 倍长焦功能还能让用户更近距离地捕捉主体。 4800 万像素融合主摄像头还采用了全新的计算成像处理流程，从而呈现锐利的细节；同时，得益于大尺寸传感器、快速光圈以及传感器位移式光学图像防抖功能，它在低光环境下也能表现出色。

Upgraded Photographic Styles with new texture and grain controls let users further dial in their desired appearance and have more creative control over their photos. 5 Under the inner display, a new FaceTime camera helps users connect with friends and family whether iPhone Duo is held open or propped on a surface for hands-free calls.
paragraphs.zh: 4800 万像素融合超广角摄像头——与 iPhone 18 Pro 机型上的摄像头相同——能够捕捉更宽广的视野并支持微距摄影，而“中心舞台”前置摄像头则能自动在任何方向拍摄照片和视频，用户无需旋转 iPhone 即可拍摄横版自拍。 升级后的摄影风格新增纹理和颗粒控制功能，让用户能进一步调整出理想的外观效果，并对照片拥有更多创意掌控。5 在屏幕内部，全新的 FaceTime 摄像头帮助用户无论 iPhone Duo 是处于展开状态还是放置在平面上，都能进行免提通话，与亲友保持联系。

paragraphs.en: The foldable design with dual displays unlocks camera experiences that are not possible on any other iPhone.
paragraphs.zh: 采用双屏的折叠式设计，带来了其他任何 iPhone 都无法实现的相机体验。

paragraphs.en: iPhone Duo supports 4K120 fps recording in Dolby Vision on the 48MP Fusion Main camera, unlocking gorgeous slow-motion effects by adjusting the playback speed. Users can now apply Cinematic effects after capture at up to 60 fps, and Audio Mix introduces new algorithms that deliver higher-quality voices and can now isolate music. Time-lapse supports 4K in Dolby Vision HDR, and users can prop iPhone Duo up without needing a tripod to easily capture longer-duration videos.

paragraphs.en: A Reimagined Yet Familiar iOS Experience
paragraphs.zh: 一种重新构想却依旧熟悉的 iOS 体验

paragraphs.en: iOS 27 is tailored for iPhone Duo, delivering a familiar and intuitive experience that introduces new ways to interact with iPhone. Lock Screen controls, the Dock on the Home Screen, and app navigation and controls now appear on the side to maximize vertical space for content. When iPhone Duo is open, the display shows two Home Screen pages with Today View — a vertically scrolling list of customizable widgets — on the left. The status bar includes a circular, flexible system that nestles into the corner of the screen, showing relevant information like Wi-Fi, cellular strength, battery, and more. The Dynamic Island is also redesigned to fit vertically on the side of the outer and inner displays, and expands to show Live Activities and alerts. iOS seamlessly adapts to the new ways to use iPhone Duo — content reacts as it folds, reorients when turned to the side, and switches to the appropriate display when flipped over.
paragraphs.zh: iOS 27 专为 iPhone Duo 打造，带来熟悉且直观的体验，并引入了与 iPhone 互动的新方式。 锁屏控件、主屏幕上的 Dock 以及应用导航和控件现在都显示在侧边，从而为内容最大化利用垂直空间。 当 iPhone Duo 处于展开状态时，显示屏左侧会显示两个主屏幕页面和“今日概览”——一个包含可自定义小组件的垂直滚动列表。 状态栏包含一个圆形、灵活的系统组件，嵌入屏幕角落，显示 Wi-Fi、蜂窝信号强度、电池电量等相关信息。 Dynamic Island 也经过重新设计，以适应内外显示屏侧边的垂直空间，并能扩展以显示实时活动和通知。iOS 能够无缝适应 iPhone Duo 的新使用方式——内容会在折叠时做出响应，在转向侧面时重新定向，并在翻转后切换到合适的显示屏。

paragraphs.en: Apple apps are optimized for iPhone Duo, and developers can easily adapt their apps using the new and updated APIs in the latest SDKs, and upcoming support for iPhone Duo in Device Hub in Xcode. Third-party apps, including Netflix, Zoom, and Slack, are already taking advantage of the folding design to deliver immersive experiences that make the most of the larger display and new ways to use iPhone Duo.
paragraphs.zh: Apple 的应用程序已针对 iPhone Duo 进行了优化，开发者可以利用最新 SDK 中全新且更新过的 API，以及 Xcode 中 Device Hub 即将支持的 iPhone Duo 功能，轻松适配自己的应用程序。 第三方应用程序（包括 Netflix、Zoom 和 Slack）已经充分利用了折叠式设计，提供了沉浸式体验，最大限度地发挥了更大显示屏的优势，并带来了使用 iPhone Duo 的新方式。

paragraphs.en: The expansive display supercharges productivity, letting users do more at once with new multitasking capabilities. Split View allows users to open two apps side by side on iPhone for the first time. Users can also quickly swap between apps; open two windows of the same app, like Safari; easily have a conversation with Siri AI while looking at content on the other side of the screen; and save pairs of apps to come back to later.
paragraphs.zh: 这块超大显示屏极大提升了工作效率，让用户借助全新的多任务处理功能一次性完成更多操作。 分屏视图首次允许用户在 iPhone 上并排打开两个应用程序。 用户还可以快速切换应用程序；同时打开同一应用的两个窗口，例如 Safari；在查看屏幕另一侧内容的同时轻松与 Siri AI 对话；并将成对的应用程序保存下来以便稍后使用。

paragraphs.en: StandBy gets a major upgrade on iPhone Duo. Set iPhone Duo down and it enters StandBy on either the outer or inner display — even when it’s not charging — turning the device into a photo frame, hub for widgets, clock, and more. New Calendar and Weather faces join existing Clock and Modular faces, while the Photos face is updated to display Shared Albums. Every face now offers deeper customization, with new colors, fonts, and complications to choose from.
paragraphs.zh: StandBy 在 iPhone Duo 上迎来重大升级。 只需将 iPhone Duo 放置下来，其外部或内部显示屏便会进入 StandBy 模式——即使设备未充电也能实现——从而将其变为相框、小组件中心、时钟等功能的集合体。 全新的日历和天气表盘加入现有的时钟和模块化表盘行列，同时照片表盘也进行了更新，可显示共享相册。 现在每种表盘都支持更深入的自定义设置，提供了更多新颜色、字体和复杂功能可供选择。

paragraphs.en: The Next Generation of Apple Intelligence and an All‑New Siri
paragraphs.zh: 新一代 Apple Intelligence 与全新 Siri

paragraphs.en: iPhone Duo gives users access to Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that is rolling out in beta with iOS 27. Powered by Apple Intelligence, Siri is profoundly more personal, capable, and conversational, and becomes even more useful on the large inner display. Powerful AI capabilities paired with personal context make iPhone Duo an intelligent personal hub with privacy and security at its core.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone Duo 让用户能够使用 Siri AI，这是 Siri 的一个全新版本，正在通过 iOS 27 以测试版形式推出。 Siri 由 Apple Intelligence 驱动，因此更加个性化、功能强大且具备对话能力，在大尺寸内屏上也能发挥更出色的作用。 强大的 AI 能力与个人化上下文相结合，使 iPhone Duo 成为一个以隐私和安全为核心的智能个人中心。

paragraphs.en: Siri AI can draw on personal context understanding to help users find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; use onscreen awareness to take action related to the content on a user’s screen; and answer questions about virtually any topic. Users can write with Siri by simply describing what they need. The all-new Siri app also makes it easy to revisit past conversations or kick off new ones, with conversational history synced privately across products with iCloud.
paragraphs.zh: Siri 人工智能可以利用对个人背景的理解，帮助用户即时在消息、电子邮件、照片等中查找所需内容；还能通过屏幕感知功能，对用户屏幕上的内容执行相关操作；此外，它几乎可以回答任何主题的问题。 用户只需描述自己的需求，就可以与 Siri 进行文字交流。 全新 Siri 应用还让回顾过往对话或开启新对话变得轻松，对话历史会通过 iCloud 在不同产品间进行私密同步。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. Users can improve the composition of a photo after it’s been taken with Spatial Reframing, Extend, and upgraded Clean Up. Image Playground also now offers photorealistic imagery, and with upcoming support for the SynthID standard, users can identify images generated or edited with AI. 6 In Safari, Notify Me helps users monitor web pages for changes, like product restocks or price drops, to stay on top of updates. To protect users’ privacy, Apple Intelligence uses on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy and security of iPhone into the cloud.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，Apple Intelligence 还能让应用程序变得更智能、更实用。 用户可以在照片拍摄后，利用空间重构图、扩展和升级后的清理功能来优化照片的构图。 Image Playground 现在也能生成逼真的图像，而随着即将推出的对 SynthID 标准的支持，用户可以识别由 AI 生成或编辑的图像。6 在 Safari 中，“通知我”功能可帮助用户监控网页变化，例如商品补货或降价，从而随时掌握最新动态。 为保护用户隐私，Apple Intelligence 采用设备端处理和“私密云计算”，将 iPhone 的隐私与安全性延伸至云端。

paragraphs.en: Pro Performance with A20 Pro and Advanced Thermal Management
paragraphs.zh: A20 Pro 与先进热管理技术带来的卓越性能

paragraphs.en: Powered by A20 Pro — the same chip in iPhone 18 Pro models — and paired with an advanced thermal management system, iPhone Duo delivers up to 35 percent better sustained performance than iPhone 17 Pro. A new chip package inspired by M-series Apple silicon connects A20 Pro directly to a custom vapor chamber, dissipating heat and powering multitasking, gaming, and complex AI workloads. A new display engine drives the inner and outer displays simultaneously and enables a fluid experience as users transition between them. The 6-core CPU is up to 20 percent faster than A19 Pro, delivering the fastest CPU in a smartphone; the 7-core GPU is up to 40 percent faster and more power efficient; and the new Dual 16-core Neural Engine offers 2x the compute power to run on-device AI models. A20 Pro also delivers 50 percent more unified memory bandwidth and is built on the latest 2-nanometer process technology.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone Duo 由 A20 Pro 芯片（与 iPhone 18 Pro 机型采用同款芯片）驱动，并搭配先进的热管理系统，其持续性能比 iPhone 17 Pro 提升高达 35%。 这款受 M 系列 Apple 硅芯片启发的新芯片封装方案，将 A20 Pro 直接连接到定制蒸汽腔，有效散发热量，为多任务处理、游戏和复杂的 AI 工作负载提供强劲动力。 全新的显示引擎可同时驱动内屏和外屏，让用户在两者之间切换时获得流畅的体验。 其 6 核 CPU 的速度比 A19 Pro 快高达 20%，是智能手机中最快的 CPU；7 核 GPU 的速度快 40% 且能效更高；全新的双 16 核神经网络引擎则提供两倍的计算能力，可运行设备端 AI 模型。 A20 Pro 还带来了 50% 更高的统一内存带宽，并基于最新的 2 纳米制程技术打造。

paragraphs.en: iPhone Duo is designed with one high-energy battery on each side to maximize capacity while efficiently using internal space. A combination of Apple silicon and energy rebalancing algorithms allows the batteries to operate seamlessly as one, so users get up to 31 hours of video playback when using the inner display, up to 44 hours of video playback when using the outer display, and up to 24 hours of usage per charge when both displays are used equally. 7 Users can also enjoy fast charging — iPhone Duo can charge up to 50 percent in around 20 minutes or wirelessly charge up to 50 percent in around 30 minutes with a MagSafe or Qi2 charger. 8
paragraphs.zh: iPhone Duo 的设计在两侧各配备一块高能量电池，从而在高效利用内部空间的同时实现最大容量。 Apple 芯片与能量再平衡算法的结合，使这两块电池能够无缝协同工作，宛如一体：使用内屏时，用户最多可获得 31 小时的视频播放时间；使用外屏时，最多可达 44 小时；若两块屏幕均衡使用，单次充电可持续使用长达 24 小时。7 此外，用户还能体验快速充电功能——iPhone Duo 约 20 分钟即可充电至 50%，或使用 MagSafe 或 Qi2 充电器在约 30 分钟内无线充电至 50%。8

paragraphs.en: iPhone Duo features an eSIM-only design worldwide that saves internal space to maximize battery capacity. 9 eSIM offers greater flexibility, better security, and seamless connectivity compared to traditional physical SIM cards, and as an industry standard, it is supported by over 500 carriers around the world, including AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon, and more. iOS 27 also introduces iPhone Handoff, which allows users with supported carriers to easily switch back and forth between two iPhone models with the same phone number. 10
paragraphs.zh: iPhone Duo 在全球范围内均采用仅支持 eSIM 的设计，从而节省内部空间，最大限度地提升电池容量。与传统实体 SIM 卡相比，9 eSIM 提供了更高的灵活性、更强的安全性和无缝的连接体验。作为行业标准，它得到了全球超过 500 家运营商的支持，包括 AT&T、T-Mobile、Verizon 等。iOS 27 还引入了 iPhone 接力功能，支持该功能的用户可以在两台 iPhone 机型之间轻松切换，并保持相同的电话号码。10

paragraphs.en: N1, an Apple-designed wireless networking chip, enables Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread, while C2, Apple’s next-generation cellular modem system, brings AI-powered improvements to cellular quality and reliability, and now supports mmWave in the U.S.
paragraphs.zh: N1 是苹果设计的无线联网芯片，支持 Wi-Fi 7、蓝牙 6 和 Thread；而 C2 则是苹果新一代蜂窝调制解调器系统，通过人工智能技术提升了蜂窝网络的质量和可靠性，并且现已在美国支持毫米波。

paragraphs.en: To complement iPhone Duo, Apple is introducing beautiful new accessories. The iPhone Duo Folio — available in navy blue and taupe — features an integrated kickstand that supports a wide range of angles for reading, viewing content, or FaceTime, and folds away neatly when not in use. The iPhone Duo Case — available in sand and navy blue — is thin and light, with a protective two-part design that wraps around both sides of the device. Both cases are compatible with MagSafe, Qi2 25W, and Qi-certified chargers. With built-in magnets that align perfectly with iPhone Duo, they offer a magical attach experience and fast wireless charging.
paragraphs.zh: 为配合 iPhone Duo，苹果正在推出多款精美配件。 iPhone Duo Folio 保护套有海军蓝和灰褐色两种颜色可选，内置可调节支架，支持多种角度，方便阅读、观看内容或进行 FaceTime 通话；不使用时还能整齐折叠收纳。 iPhone Duo 保护壳有沙色和海军蓝两种颜色可选，轻薄小巧，采用双层防护设计，能包裹住设备的两侧。 这两款保护壳均兼容 MagSafe、Qi2 25W 以及通过 Qi 认证的充电器。 它们内置的磁铁能与 iPhone Duo 完美对齐，带来神奇的磁吸体验，并支持快速无线充电。

paragraphs.en: iPhone Duo was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 35 percent recycled content overall, 11 including 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery and 100 percent recycled titanium in the 3D-printed hinge cover. iPhone Duo is manufactured with 60 percent renewable energy, like wind and solar, across the supply chain, and meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. Like all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 12 and can be easily recycled at home.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone Duo 的设计充分考虑了环境因素，推动了苹果实现“到 2030 年使其整个业务足迹实现碳中和”这一宏伟计划的进程。 该产品的整体回收材料含量为 35%，其中包括电池中 100% 回收的钴和 3D 打印铰链盖中 100% 回收的钛。iPhone Duo 在整个供应链中采用 60% 的可再生能源（如风能和太阳能）进行制造，并符合苹果在能源效率和安全化学配方方面的高标准。 与所有苹果产品一样，其纸质包装完全由纤维制成，并且可以在家中轻松回收。

paragraphs.en: Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.
paragraphs.zh: 1984年，苹果推出Macintosh，彻底改变了个人技术领域。 如今，苹果凭借iPhone、iPad、Mac、AirPods、Apple Watch和Apple Vision Pro，在全球创新领域处于领先地位。 苹果的六大软件平台——iOS、iPadOS、macOS、watchOS、visionOS和tvOS——为所有苹果设备提供了无缝衔接的体验，并通过App Store、Apple Music、Apple Pay、iCloud和Apple TV等突破性服务为用户赋能。 苹果超过15万名员工致力于创造地球上最出色的产品，并努力让世界比我们接手时更加美好。
